- **Origin:** Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v2 c16 P14](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0014), [v3 c4 P6](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0006), [v3 c4 P31](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0031)</sub>
- **Role:** student and former schoolteacher  <sub>[v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v3 c3 P15](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0015), [v3 c4 P2](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0002), [v3 c37 P9](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0009)</sub>

## Appearance

Priscilla is a pale, spiritual-looking maiden who is golden and fair in silk attire. She is tall, standing a good two inches taller than most of the crowd at college.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c20 P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v3 c4 P6](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0006)_

## Personality

Despite her ethereal appearance, Priscilla is full to the brim of mischief, pranks, and fun. She enjoys gay chatter and joking with her close friends, often poking subtle fun at others for entertainment. Resolute when making house rules, she is also cheerful, helpful, and appreciative of life's finer qualities.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 c3 P24](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0024), [v3 c6 P12](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0012), [v3 c10 P56](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0056), [v3 c36 P21](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0021), [v3 c37 P23](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0023)_

## History

Priscilla studied at Queen's Academy, where she became close friends with Anne Shirley and Stella Maynard. After graduating, she taught school at Carmody before taking over her own home school on the Island. She participated in the Avonlea Village Improvement Society, contributing a paper on cemeteries. Later, after obtaining her father's consent, she enrolled at Redmond College in Kingsport alongside Anne. Together with Anne, Stella, and Philippa Gordon, she lived at Patty's Place under the chaperonage of Aunt Jamesina. During her college years, she devoted herself to classics, spent a summer visiting Anne in Avonlea, and completed her final Senior examinations at Redmond.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 c1 P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 c15 P23](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0023), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v3 c1 P21](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0021), [v3 c3 P10](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0010), [v3 c10 P52](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0052), [v3 c16 P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 c23 P1](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0001), [v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028), [v3 c37 P9](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0009)_

## Quotes

> I would wish to be famous,  <sub>[v2 c13 P34](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0034)</sub>

> And your own is a white violet, with purple streaks in its heart,  <sub>[v2 c13 P71](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0071)</sub>

> There's just one more thing. You, Phil, as all Redmond knows, entertain callers almost every evening. Now, at Patty's Place we can't do that. We have decided that we shall be at home to our friends on Friday evenings only. If you come with us you'll have to abide by that rule.  <sub>[v3 c10 P56](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0056)</sub>

> I shall have to fall back on another Professor Woodleigh quotation to express what it has done for me. You remember that he said in his address, ‘There is so much in the world for us all if we only have the eyes to see it, and the heart to love it, and the hand to gather it to ourselves—so much in men and women, so much in art and literature, so much everywhere in which to delight, and for which to be thankful.’ I think Redmond has taught me that in some measure, Anne.  <sub>[v3 c37 P23](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0023)</sub>
